ProjectWeave request for the selected Task (data):
{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjccM8AAAABZhl_XA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IfzhDIjPQ", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3If", "number": 59, "title": "Correct V30MZ DAA/DAS flags and execution clocks", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `da4b5ecb2f2c72c779b033e08b4946c628a28b30`, `crates/ws-core/src/cpu.rs:729–754` preserves incoming OF, derives an extra DAS carry from adjustment borrow, and leaves both instructions on the default one-clock execution component. Incorrect flags affect BCD arithmetic and subsequent branches; understated clocks affect shared device scheduling. Commercial-title impact remains unmeasured.

Static deductions from inspected code and experiment calculators, not planning-time executions:

| Instruction | Input AX / FLAGS | Current AX / FLAGS | Expected AX / FLAGS |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| DAA | `007A / F002` | `0080 / F092` | `0080 / F892` |
| DAS | `0000 / F012` | `00FA / F097` | `00FA / F096` |
| DAA | `0000 / F802` | `0000 / F846` | `0000 / F046` |

The existing decimal-conversion smoke test checks ordinary AX results without complete DAA/DAS flag or clock assertions.

## Expected outcome

Correct ordinary DAA (`27`, ADJ4A) and DAS (`2F`, ADJ4S) decoding across emulated Mono/Color/SwanCrystal model configurations:

- Determine high adjustment from incoming CF or original AL exceeding `99`; determine low adjustment from incoming AF or the original low nibble exceeding nine.
- Add/subtract the selected `60` and `06` adjustments modulo 256. Preserve AH. CF and AF equal their respective adjustment conditions; adjustment overflow/borrow must not independently set them.
- Derive SZP from final AL. Derive OF as the pinned calculator's byte `CMP final_AL, original_AL` does, replacing incoming OF. Preserve control/fixed flags and unrelated state.
- Use ten execution clocks plus existing fetch/wait charges.

Limit production changes to these instructions and necessary tests, original fixtures, browser assertions and documentation. Broader prefetch, exceptional arithmetic and unrelated hardware remain separate work.

## Context

Local HEAD and inspected remote main match the baseline; the checkout is clean. The open Issue/PR collection is empty, and all 58 closed-work titles contain no equivalent completed DAA/DAS correction. [Issue #57](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/issues/57) and [PR #58](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/pull/58) corrected AAA/AAS separately.

The inspected [WSCPUTest report](https://github.com/FluBBaOfWard/WSCPUTest/blob/245b12c06dede4a2bb9c04c942ebca2044ba4930/README.md#daa--adj4a) and [DAA/DAS comparisons and calculators](https://github.com/FluBBaOfWard/WSCPUTest/blob/245b12c06dede4a2bb9c04c942ebca2044ba4930/WSCpuTest.asm#L6075) supply the instruction-specific flag requirements. The experiment compares complete FLAGS under contrasting inputs. Its fixed expected constants include experiment-specific IF; preserve emulator control bits instead of copying those constants unconditionally. Experiment source was inspected without execution or independent per-model silicon logs. Applicability across models/modes is an instruction-level inference.

The inspected [NEC V30MZ manual](https://www.renesas.com/en/document/lbr/v30mztm-hardware-preliminary), Appendix A, Table A-1, specifies ten execution clocks for ADJ4A/ADJ4S after decoding under stated conditions. Adding existing fetch charges preserves the repository's bounded timing policy; complete pipeline accuracy is not established.

Correction record: replace preserved-OF, borrow-derived DAS-CF and default-cost assumptions with the experiment's complete flag rules and the manual's ten-clock component. Record the original assumptions, corrected requirements, references and rationale. Evidence-based corrections to AI-authored requirements require neither human approval nor independent AI re-review; retain the agreed goal and relevant acceptance.

[Saved #57 validation](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/blob/da4b5ecb2f2c72c779b033e08b4946c628a28b30/docs/issue-57-validation.md) reports 158 core unit tests, 30 integration tests, one adapter test and complete production Chromium suites passing. These are saved results, not executions performed here. The report and PR still request final Coordinator review; the inspected published reviews collection is empty. Existing results do not establish DAA/DAS correctness or commercial compatibility.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Correct both instructions through ordinary decoding. Assert one-byte consumption, continuation, AH preservation, complete FLAGS and unchanged unrelated registers, segments, memory, ports and saves. Preserve existing prefix and interrupt behavior, including saved flags and continuation through interrupt entry/IRET.
- [ ] Add independent literal AX/full-FLAGS expectations for all reproductions above and adjustment boundaries around `09/0A`, `79/7A`, `7F/80`, `99/9A`, `F9/FA/FF`, including incoming-CF-only, incoming-AF-only and combined adjustments. Cover all 256 AL values and four incoming AF/CF combinations with opposing OF/SZP/control profiles and contrasting AH values. Document independent tables/vectors; expected results must not call production adjustment/ALU helpers. Exercise actual flag-dependent branches.
- [ ] Cover all nine supported static model/mode configurations and Color/Crystal runtime round trips `00→80→00→C0→00→E0→00`. Check RAM and mapped-ROM fetches with waits enabled/disabled. Assert ten execution clocks plus actual existing fetch charges: unprefixed RAM/fast-ROM totals eleven clocks; waited-ROM totals twelve. Use normal Machine scheduling to demonstrate returned clocks advance timers, raster/frame state and PCM once; preserve existing DMA accounting.
- [ ] Extend the original source-included CC0 conversion probe through the existing NASM/`fixtures/build.py` pipeline, or add an equally focused probe. Native and production Chromium/Wasm checks must compare CPU-written AX, full FLAGS and branch observations against independent literals across every model, supported runtime transitions and fresh restart. Clear volatile observations and invalidate poisoned retained success. Record focused native and cartridge failures against unchanged baseline handlers, configurations reached, and corrected passes. Preserve existing AAA/AAS and AAM/AAD observations.
- [ ] Before merge, the Coordinator passes `python3 fixtures/build.py --check`, `python3 demo/build.py --check`, `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo test --workspace --locked`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, and `git diff --check`. In `web`, pass `npm run build:wasm`, `npm run build`, then complete `npm run test:browser` and `npm run test:compat` sequentially against a locally served production preview. Record the final functional revision covered by each result.
- [ ] Preserve prior CPU/prefix/interrupt acceptance and existing three-model startup/firmware, video/input/frame, audio/PCM, GDMA/SDMA/Hyper Voice, RTC transport, SRAM/EEPROM and Wasm/browser lifecycle/save-integrity behavior. Preserve ROM identity, browser-local ownership and provenance policies; require no proprietary ROM or firmware.
- [ ] Update hardware-subset, source-reconciliation and fixture/provenance documentation. Record actual commands, failures, resolutions, passes and unperformed checks. The Coordinator reviews the final diff against every checkbox before merge, distinguishing tests present from reported execution and retaining hardware/commercial uncertainties.

## Optional validation

Baseline production-browser discrimination, additional browser engines and additional lawfully available software. Physical-console measurements and human gameplay are optional evidence and were unperformed during planning. Planning changed no files, published no remote content, spawned no agents and ran no application builds/tests.

## Required post-merge verification

None

## Specification reconciliation

Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance criteria when primary hardware
specifications establish the correction. Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.

This autonomous campaign has no human-approval gate. Mandatory acceptance uses
automated native and production-browser tests on the emulator's supported model
and mode configurations. Physical-console measurements and human gameplay are
optional evidence and must remain explicitly unperformed unless actually available.
Do not invent device identities, real-device results or a requirement for human
confirmation. Resolve technical errors with recorded evidence and automated checks
through the existing Coordinator workflow.
